OHDSI OMOP Medical Imaging CDM Concept Crosswalk

Source: R/data-omop.R
omop_imaging_concepts.Rd

Curated reference crosswalk mapping DICOM modalities, anatomic sites, quantitative TID 1500 / segmentation features, UCUM units, and provenance type codes onto standard OHDSI OMOP, SNOMED CT, LOINC, and RadLex concepts.

Usage

data(omop_imaging_concepts)

Format

A tibble with 52 rows and 8 variables:

concept_id

Integer OMOP standard concept identifier.

concept_name

Human-readable concept name.

domain_id

OMOP domain ("Procedure", "Spec Anatomic Site", "Measurement", "Unit", "Type Concept").

vocabulary_id

Source vocabulary ("SNOMED", "LOINC", "RadLex", "UCUM", "OMOP", "Type Concept").

concept_class_id

OMOP concept class.

concept_code

Vocabulary-specific concept code.

dicom_code

Normalized DICOM / dicomtk lookup key.

category

Crosswalk category ("modality", "anatomic_site", "feature", "unit", "feature_type").

Source

OHDSI Medical Imaging Working Group (MI-CDM) & DICOM PS3.16.
